NEXT: B3 = P1 deliver onward. It waits for the leader's own brief and dispatch-floor; start nothing before it. Read WCLI-21's notes first: BINDING ON 4a-2b-2 PART B, BINDING ON PART B (#370 r3), the DEC-262 (a32)-(a34) quotes, the EXECUTION CHOICE note, BINDING ON B2 AMENDED and the OWED TO B3 note, and read the rulings verbatim from opum-doc origin/dev .quest/planning.json via git -C /Volumes/external/repos/opum-doc show --no-ext-diff --no-textconv origin/dev:.quest/planning.json (never fetch in opum-doc; the ref is as last fetched, say so when quoting).
OWED TO B3 (all recorded on WCLI-21): P1 creates ~/ward-t26-wcli21 EXCLUSIVELY (one non-recursive mkdir, 0700, fails if present), writes the binaries into it with sha256 at both ends; facts/seal/unseal/clean each re-assert it with lstat (real directory, not symlink, owned by the running uid, mode exactly 0700, the ruled literal path); each phase makes its own interposers-<phase> exclusively inside it; P4 deletes by the literal path and MUST pass passwdHome() to removeRunDirectoryUnder (the rm -rf anchor in harness-source.ts allows exactly that call); the harness never deletes or renames anything outside its own run directory; real-ward-metadata baseline taken at the START of P1 and compared at P4; P2 before-lists are the run baseline for handle lists, P4 after-lists also compared (persistent lists must match, transient only within a phase); tcti-is-device-tpmrm0 and handle-lists-unchanged owed by P2, P3, P4 only; the control call for envControlRow runs its own /usr/bin/env interposer OUTSIDE the phase call log and its stdout is read as latin1; production listWindowRoots call passes NO third argument; the window listing fails on any non-UTF-8 name (count only in the report; the remedy is the operator renaming it); seal and unseal use groupsRow (ids AND names), never the ids-only groupIdsRow that P0 uses (the N-5 test pins groupIdsRow to exactly its definition and the one runFacts call); P3 records the interpreter it ACTUALLY RUNS for /usr/bin/python3 -I (path and version from that run) and fails closed until B3 produces it; boot_id: strip exactly ONE trailing newline from both reads (rows.ts stripOneNewline exists) plus a stability control reading boot_id twice at P3 and a test that the boot-id row's ok comes only from bootIdChanged; the N1 log-scan layout (containing() takes a directory only; keep the harness log under the scan or scan the run root excluding exactly state.json); check on P0 that the jetson /usr/bin/env supports -0. Importing rows and shim into qualify-linux.ts at P2 pulls src/adapters/tpm2-tools.ts into the bundle: its spawn allowance is already settled in harness-source.ts (tpm2-tools.ts and inherited-acl.ts), and the closure test will go red on any NEW spawn site, non-code import or attributes clause. A PR over about 400 lines is split at a phase boundary and the split reported BEFORE pushing (B1's order was wrong once: I pushed first and apologised).
OWED NOT BUILT: F1-F4 from the #410 round-5 review (on WCLI-21): F1 attributes-clause throw bypassed by a comment before with/assert (leader ruling: stated limit, one-line fix owed: allow (?:\s|/\*[\s\S]*?\*/|//[^\n]*\n)* before (with|assert), plus a case); F2 a case for the |\$\{ lookahead branch alone ('export const p = "reboot" + `${x}`;'); F3 an assert case; F4 /index.jsx and /index.mjs cases. STATED LIMITS of the lexical tripwire (verdict findings 8 and 9): dbus-send/gdbus dotted literals, kexec, routes that spawn nothing (ffi reboot(2), /proc/sysrq-trigger, process.kill(1), raw D-Bus), values built at run time from non-adjacent pieces; the real guarantee is that no P1-P4 code path builds a reboot or shutdown command, which each slice proves by its own wiring and review. WCLI-174 (Linux evidence for the replacement test, incl. M28 once on the arm runner) and WCLI-175 are To Do, not started, awaiting the leader's plan approval. 4a-3 (packaged smoke, pty bridge, ward workflow, T05 scan) is a separate PR after B; 4b (the recorded run, ADR 0028 and the T26 report naming the four stripped names _, SHLVL, PWD, OLDPWD and the pin, the phrase 'Ward plus a logging shim in front of the trusted binaries' verbatim) comes after the hardware run; ADR 0028 and the report are OWED and do not exist.

HOLDS THAT STAND: NOTHING has run on the jetson (no phase, probe or copy), and --build has not run. --build CLEARANCE (leader, as held earlier, record not found on WCLI-21 by the round-2 review, so confirm it with the leader before relying on it): local Mac, bun scripts/qualify-linux.ts --build <dir>, an expected cache hit on bun-linux-aarch64-v1.3.14 (~/.bun/install/cache, 91801560 bytes, dated Sep 7); record whether any fetch happened and the sha256 of the cached runtime and both output binaries; if it tries to reach anything other than Bun's GitHub release, STOP and REPORT. The jetson run waits until 4a-2b and 4a-3 have landed; then P0-P2 run as proposed, at P2 report the four handle lists and the run-directory state and HOLD before P3 until the leader relays that the reboot is confirmed; never reboot anything. Do not remove, deregister or prune any worktree (DEC-208, LCLI-740 open): every .claude/worktrees/review-* and agent-* stays, including review-406-*, review-408-*, review-410-* (b76f809 .. d51c896) and the prunable /private/tmp scratchpad entry. NEVER git add -A or git add . (.claude/worktrees/ is untracked); add named paths (git add -A .quest/ only after quest task complete).
BUDGET: the shared account was near 98% of its weekly limit; it resets Nov 21 at 10am CT. Spend only inside the assigned slice.

PROCESS RULES THAT HELD (this session): branch first from origin/dev (merge origin/dev before a quest write); git push alone in its own Bash call (the guard hook refuses a composed push); gh pr merge bare with --match-head-commit copied from a gh pr view headRefOid read in the same sequence; gh pr checks --watch after a first-seconds 'no checks reported'; every review round is NEW commits on the PR branch, never a rebase or force-push; cut a fresh detached .claude/worktrees/review-<pr>-<sha7> at each green head and send the path and head to team-lead; mutant predictions are COMMITTED before the run and never edited, observations go in a later commit with divergences stated plainly (this session: X1, U1, T6, R1, V2 diverged and were recorded as such); edit mutants and files with python or the Edit tool using LITERAL paths (the ownership guard refuses shell-built targets like $F or $SP/..; read a verdict file with cat from its literal path); after a formatter run, VERIFY an Edit actually applied (the R1 'green' mutant was a silently missed replace); a test file that names src/adapters/ must import ./support/no-real-keychain.ts as its FIRST import (test-isolation rule); Bun spawnSync of a missing binary gives status undefined, not null; /bin/true does not exist on a Mac (use /usr/bin/true); quest task complete needs In Progress first and takes --final-summary; quest complete moves the record, so git add -A .quest/; quest edits take --actor ward-cli-worker --actor-kind delegated-agent --accountable-human jdnewhouse; reply to the leader by native team mail to team-lead and answer each nonce check with exactly its line; fence DEC-182 (1): stop and report before committing a CI workflow, ruleset, dependency or lockfile, settings or permissions, plugin manifest, install or session hook, build, runtime pin, launcher, pins, required-check logic, release or publish path, auth, secrets or credentials change.
